# DogsBay XML — Getting started

## Getting started

- [DogsBay XML overview](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/getting-started/dogsbay-xml-overview.md): What the editor does, who it is for, and the three ideas that shape it.
- [Installing](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/getting-started/install.md): Install DogsBay XML, put its command line on your PATH, and turn on the integration server.
- [Tutorial: Fixing a DITA project by hand](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/getting-started/tutorial-manual.md): Open a real DITA project that has problems in it, find them with the project tools, and fix one of them by hand.
- [Tutorial: Using an agent to fix a DITA project](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/getting-started/tutorial-agentic.md): Open a real DITA project that has problems in it, find them with the project tools, and fix them with the AI agent.
